notes: Device presets with the real iPhone Dynamic Island measurements — 14/15 Pro, both Pro Max sizes, 16 Pro and 16 Pro Max
iOS mode: pure black, fully rounded, a 44 dp corner when open, an optional camera lens, and SwiftUI's own damped-spring motion rather than an ease curve
A tap now steps the island up one size at a time: pill, compact preview, small card, everything, then back to rest
Swipe down skips the steps and opens everything at once
Tap behaviour is a setting, so a single tap can still open the full panel outright
The in-app preview steps the same way, with a Small stage between Preview and Full
